description: A right-side expander for Merc8or that goes immediately beside it, adding CV control of its output range along with remote inverting and linking.

params.text: Inverts Merc8or's output range each time it is pressed.
Chooses whether the invert jack is read as a trigger that flips the state or as a gate that holds it while high.
Holds Merc8or's two output range voltages a fixed distance apart, so moving its output LOW knob carries the HIGH one with it; while this is on, the invert controls do nothing.

inputs.text: Inverts Merc8or's output range: with the switch set to Trig a rising edge past 2V flips it, and with the switch set to Gate it stays inverted only while the voltage is above 0V.
Sets Merc8or's output HIGH directly, -10V to +10V; it does nothing while LINK is on.
Sets Merc8or's output LOW directly, -10V to +10V.

notes: A lamp in the name of each module lights when this is attached to a Merc8or. With no Merc8or on its left, nothing here has any effect.
Patching either range jack disables the invert controls, and patching both disables the link as well.

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
